title: Sewage-contaminated tap water kills up to 7 in Indore's Bhagirathpura
detail: Sewage leaking into a drinking-water main caused an outbreak from late December; the mayor cited 7 deaths (health department confirmed 3) and over 200 hospitalised. The state announced compensation and municipal officials were suspended.
agency: Indore Municipal Corporation / MP Health Department

title: Three Indians from Myawaddy scam centres repatriated via Yangon
detail: The Embassy of India in Yangon said three nationals held in Myawaddy scam centres were repatriated, taking the total since July 2022 to 2,171, and warned against unverified overseas job offers.

title: Bus plunges into gorge near Haripurdhar, Sirmaur; 14 dead
detail: A bus carrying 66 passengers from Solan skidded off a mountain road into a deep gorge near Haripurdhar; state minister Jagat Singh Negi put the toll at 14 with about 40 injured. Xinhua reported the crash on Friday (9 January); its article is dated 10 January.

title: Army fires at suspected Pakistani drones along LoC in Rajouri
detail: Troops fired at drone-like objects that crossed the LoC near Dunga Gala (Chingus) and Dheri Dhara in Rajouri; they returned to PoK and searches for airdrops followed. Similar activity was reported days earlier in Rajouri, Poonch and Samba.

title: Two Nipah cases confirmed among health workers in Barasat, West Bengal
detail: WHO reported two laboratory-confirmed Nipah virus cases, both healthcare workers, confirmed 13 January in Barasat; over 190 contacts tested negative. WHO rated risk moderate sub-nationally and low nationally and globally.

title: Shah reviews LWE in Raipur, reiterates March 31 deadline
detail: At a Raipur review, Home Minister Amit Shah said Naxalism would be eradicated before 31 March 2026 and cited 500+ Naxalites killed, about 1,900 arrested and 2,500+ surrendered since January 2024.
attribution: Claim by Home Minister Amit Shah

title: Two JeM militants killed in Kishtwar's Chatroo
detail: Army, J&K Police and CRPF killed two Jaish-e-Mohammad militants in the Chatroo belt under Operation Trashi-I; AK-47 rifles recovered.
attribution: Army/J&K Police claims via Deccan Herald

title: Air India, IndiGo and Air India Express suspend Middle East flights
detail: After US and Israeli strikes on Iran, Air India and IndiGo suspended all Middle East flights and Air India Express its Gulf flights until 1 March, offering refunds and free rebooking.

title: Infiltration bid foiled at Bhimber Gali on LoC
detail: The Army said terrorist movement was detected in the Bhimber Gali area in early morning and troops prevented a breach; alert heightened along the LoC and IB.

title: ED has 257 cyber-crime PMLA cases, Rs 35,925 crore proceeds
detail: The government told Parliament that as of 28 Feb 2026 ED had 257 cybercrime-linked PMLA cases with Rs 35,925.58 crore identified proceeds; the suspect registry had blocked Rs 9,518.91 crore and the I4C fraud reporting system recovered over Rs 8,690 crore. Source gives only "March 2026"; the day is a placeholder.

title: Rs 23.72 crore meth found in truck near Myanmar border
detail: Assam Rifles and Mizoram Police found 7.907 kg of methamphetamine tablets worth Rs 23.72 crore in an abandoned truck on Hmunhmeltha Road; officials suspect origin in Myanmar's Chin State.

title: RBI expands MuleHunter.AI, revises e-banking fraud rules
detail: RBI said it revised its 2017 rules on unauthorised electronic transactions (draft issued 6 Mar 2026) and that its MuleHunter.AI tool to detect mule accounts is live in 26 banks and expanding.

title: ED attaches Rs 1,700 crore Dubai, Delhi assets in Mahadev case
detail: ED attached 18 Dubai and 2 Delhi properties worth Rs 1,700 crore linked to Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar; it cites 175+ searches and 13 arrests so far.

title: Government declares India free of Maoist insurgency
detail: Home Minister Amit Shah told Parliament India was free of Naxalites, while saying all but two Maoist commanders had been killed or surrendered; he cited 364 insurgents killed, 1,022 arrested and 2,337 surrendered in 2025.
attribution: Government claim by Amit Shah via AFP

title: Police raid 'mini Jamtara' cyber-fraud village near Kanpur
detail: Police using drone surveillance raided Reuna village, Ghatampur, arresting 20 (15 escaped); callers allegedly posed as officials offering loans or housing schemes, and SIM cards, laptops and evidence of 20-50 mule accounts were seized.

title: CBI arrests bank official, two others in Rs 1.6 crore digital-arrest case
detail: CBI searched five locations in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and arrested three people including a bank official over a Rs 1.6 crore digital-arrest fraud on a senior citizen; mule accounts and layered transactions were found.

title: Mini-bus of Kerala tourists falls into gorge in Tamil Nadu; 10 dead
detail: A mini-bus carrying 16 people from Kerala on a leisure trip fell into a deep gorge in Tamil Nadu, killing at least 10, per Xinhua citing All India Radio; police opened a case.
place: Tamil Nadu hills (exact site not given)

title: Firecracker factory blast kills 21 in Virudhunagar
detail: An explosion while workers moved flammable chemicals destroyed a fireworks factory at V. Muthulingapuram, killing 21 and injuring 6, per Xinhua citing All India Radio; about 50 labourers were inside.

title: Delhi hottest day of year at 42.8C; heatwave alerts across north and east
detail: Safdarjung hit 42.8C, 5.1C above normal; IMD issued orange alert for Delhi and heatwave warnings for J&K, HP, Punjab, Haryana, UP, MP, Vidarbha, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, West Bengal and Odisha.

title: Two Bangladeshis killed in BSF firing in Sepahijala
detail: BSF said a group challenged at the zero line in Sepahijala district pelted troops with stones and that personnel fired pump-action guns in self-defence; two men died in hospital.

title: Army kills intruder in Krishna Ghati sector, Poonch
detail: The Army's White Knight Corps said one intruder was neutralised after being detected about 300 m inside Indian territory near Mankote; sources linked him to Lashkar-e-Taiba.

title: Bangladeshi cattle-lifting suspect killed in Cooch Behar
detail: BSF said troops fired after repeated warnings at 10-12 intruders crossing near border pillar 905 in Cooch Behar district to lift cattle; one was killed.

title: Heatwave kills over 100 in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
detail: Khaleej Times reported over 100 heat deaths across the two states, including 23 in Warangal in one day, with highs of 48.3C at Chityala; Telangana's revenue minister ordered early warnings and cold-water points, and IMD warned heat would continue in the north.

title: India-China WMCC talks in Beijing on LAC
detail: The Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination met in Beijing; MEA called talks constructive and said both sides would prepare for the next Special Representatives meeting and hold expert talks on trans-border rivers.

title: Under-construction Betwa River bridge collapses in storm; 6 workers dead
detail: Police and officials said an under-construction bridge over the Betwa linking Morakandar and Kandaur villages collapsed during a late-night storm on Thursday 28 May, killing six labourers and injuring three.

title: MEA: 2,400+ Indians repatriated from Myanmar scam compounds
detail: The MEA said more than 2,400 Indians had been repatriated from cyber scam compounds in Myanmar while about 150 remained trapped.

title: BSF recovers 18 kg drone-dropped heroin in Amritsar
detail: BSF detected drone activity and recovered about 18 kg of heroin near BOPs Ramkot and Kakkar in the Lopoke sector; no arrests at time of reporting.

title: Monsoon reaches Kerala late; IMD forecasts 90% of LPA
detail: The southwest monsoon reached Kerala on 4 June, three days after normal and nine days after IMD's forecast of 26 May; IMD forecast below-normal rain at 90% of LPA amid developing El Nino.
attribution: IMD forecast via Down To Earth

title: ICU fire at private hospital in Muzaffarpur kills 5
detail: A pre-dawn fire in the ICU of a private hospital in Muzaffarpur killed five and burned 20; local media blamed a short circuit, per Xinhua.

title: ED searches over 36,000 Indian SIMs active in Cambodia
detail: ED searched seven sites in Kishangarh, Jodhpur, Nagpur and Ludhiana under PMLA over misuse of SIM cards by point-of-sale vendors; it said 36,000 Indian SIMs were active in Cambodia, 5,300 linked to fraud cases, and 30 bank accounts were identified.

title: CBI arrests two over trafficking youth to Myanmar/Cambodia scam compounds
detail: CBI arrested two alleged key traffickers in Delhi; one allegedly arranged transit to Myanmar via Thailand and the other ran an office inside a scam compound near the Thai-Myanmar border, managing sub-agents and taking crypto payments.

title: Pune moves to alternate-day water supply as delayed monsoon drains dams
detail: Pune Municipal Corporation cut supply from 1,600 to 1,100 million litres a day with alternate-day service, and Pimpri-Chinchwad also imposed cuts, as the monsoon stalled about 200 km from the city.

title: ED attaches Rs 940.77 crore more in Mahadev betting probe
detail: ED provisionally attached property, land and securities worth Rs 940.77 crore of a businessman and associated entities in the Mahadev Online Book/Skyexchange case, taking the total attached, seized or frozen to about Rs 3,800 crore.

title: Flash flood in Rajouri; 15 rain deaths in Jammu region
detail: A flash flood in Rajouri caused extensive damage; a senior police official said 15 people died in rain-related incidents in Poonch, Rajouri and Doda, with several missing and 11 rescued by Army and state responders.
attribution: Senior police official via Al Jazeera

title: Landslides kill 9 in Nagaland's Mon district
detail: The Mon district magistrate said 9 people were killed and at least 15 injured in landslides; 4 of 8 bodies had been recovered as rescue continued.
attribution: Mon district magistrate via Al Jazeera

title: Deep depression floods north Odisha; 1 lakh+ affected
detail: Over 1 lakh people were affected in Balasore, Jajpur, Bhadrak and Mayurbhanj, with 23,650+ relocated and about 300 houses damaged; Balasore logged 246 mm in 24 h. Lightning killed 3 in Chhattisgarh's MCB district.
attribution: State officials and IMD via ETV Bharat

title: Residential building collapse in Bhiwandi kills at least 9
detail: Local officials said a multi-storey residential building collapsed in Bhiwandi near Mumbai, killing at least nine with others trapped as rescue continued overnight.

title: Monsoon floods and landslides kill 100+ since July
detail: Official data cited by Al Jazeera put Assam deaths at 87 (47 in Sivasagar district), Kerala at 15 with 7 missing and 10,000+ in 300+ relief camps, and J&K at 31 from intense rain bursts.
attribution: State officials and broadcaster figures via Al Jazeera

title: Lightning kills 14 farm workers in Jharkhand
detail: IMD-cited figures reported by Al Jazeera said 14 people, mainly farm workers in open fields, were killed by lightning in Jharkhand during the monsoon.

title: ~500 Rajasthan youths went to SE Asian scam centres: police
detail: A Rajasthan State Cyber Police officer, citing I4C inputs, said about 500 youths from the state had travelled to scam centres in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam; about eight repeat travellers have been arrested and Beawar, Shekhawati and Udaipur are being monitored.

title: Firecracker unit blast in Kaushambi kills 11, including 8 children
detail: Police said an explosion at a firecracker factory in Kaushambi district collapsed nearby houses, killing at least 11 people including eight children; the cause was unclear.

title: Pastor shot, homes burned in Kangpokpi village
detail: Human Rights Watch reported that a pastor was shot and homes were burned in Old Tapon village, Kangpokpi district, amid Naga-Kuki clashes.

title: HRW: 34 dead in Manipur Naga-Kuki violence since February
detail: Human Rights Watch said renewed Naga vs Kuki-Zo violence killed 34 people since February 2026, including at least 7 in late August; 48 people were reportedly abducted in May after three Kuki church leaders were killed.

title: CBI Operation Chakra-VI hits 89 digital-arrest sites in 20 states
detail: CBI searched 89 locations across 20 states against digital-arrest syndicates and arrested three people accused of receiving and moving fraud proceeds through purpose-opened bank accounts; linked cases total about Rs 42.36 crore (Gujarat Rs 19.24 cr, Karnataka Rs 15.45 cr, Rajasthan Rs 7.67 cr).

title: Meth tablets worth Rs 5.59 crore seized at Seling
detail: Assam Rifles and NCB Aizawl intercepted two vehicles and seized 6.991 kg of methamphetamine tablets valued at about Rs 5.59 crore; two arrested.

title: Deep depression crosses coast near Kalingapatnam
detail: A Bay of Bengal deep depression crossed near Kalingapatnam overnight 23-24 Sept; over 8,000 were evacuated (about 5,000 to 264 shelters in Gajapati), one died in a house collapse in Balasore, and IMD kept red warnings for Koraput, Malkangiri, Kalahandi and Nabarangpur to 25 Sept.
attribution: IMD and state officials via ETV Bharat
